newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 14.0/15.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 14.0/15.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 14.0/15.0 percent on Monday amid adequate rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
One Japanese bank dealer said the overnight money tended to ease but overall trading activity was slow.
Dealers said an early central bank injection of some 893 billion rupiah in addition to offers mainly from state-owned banks helped eased the rates which hovered at around 16.0/17.0 on Friday.
One local bank dealer said one-week money was at 14.00/14.25 and two-week money at 14.25/14.50 percent. One-month money was stable at 14.0/15.25.
The average overnight interbank rate on Friday was 16.92 compared with 12.82 percent on Thursday.
